name: lucidity-fleet
description: Lucidity Fleet: orchestrator, MCP diffusion server, and phone-first PWA for a Tailscale-only local inference fleet (opencode + LM Studio + ComfyUI).

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w orchestrator && npm run build -w mcp-diffusion && npm run build -w pwa
scripts.test: npm run test -w orchestrator && npm run test -w mcp-diffusion
